spots.name: Mural Diversidad
spots.blurb: You've reached Mural Diversidad, a mural. Monumento a la Diversidad en plaza Alberdi.

spots.name: El Quijote
spots.blurb: You've reached El Quijote, a mural by Miguel Rep. Pintado sobre una de las paredes de Casa de López. Hermana a la Ciudad de Azul con la de Alcalá de Henares en España (lugar de nacimiento de Miguel de Cervantes Saavedra).

spots.name: Adolfo Pérez Esquivel
spots.blurb: You've reached Adolfo Pérez Esquivel, a mural. Street art changes fast, so if the wall has been repainted, look around: the next piece is often close by.
